about_the_game:
RISE is a co-op climbing game for 1–8 players. Join a team of old friends and work together to scale ancient summits on majestic sky islands. Just make sure to reach the top before nightfall.

TRY THE DEMO

This demo features the first RISE map 'Elder Crag'. Climb a hand-made route to reach the peak and experience interesting choices and challenges on your journey to the top.

JOURNEY UP

Rise to the top using climbing axes, carefully cross narrow beams, and leap far with low gravity, but step carefully because even a slight slip can lead to big trouble.

BOOST YOUR ENERGY

Find wild mushrooms which provide useful power-ups and look out for helpful items left behind by previous climbers. 

NO WAITING AROUND

Use save points along the trail to get straight back to climbing with your friends after a fall.
 



FEATURES

  • Online co-op and offline solo play - up to 8 players! 

  • Proximity chat + walkie talkies for long range communication 

  • Binoculars to scout ahead and a camera to take pictures 

  • Old People
